Name: (FF-CP) Exhibition Stand
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]This is a Exhibition Stand that can hold multiple items.[/size][/color]

[size=4][color=#6d9eeb]Please be sure to check the required mods.[/color][/size]

[size=2][color=#d4d4d8]To place an item on a stand, hold the item in your hand and left-click on the stand.[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#d4d4d8](In vanilla games, you right-click to access tables, but this mod works differently.)[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#d4d4d8]There are 5 types of wooden stands (with frames).
There are 9 types of stone stands (without frames).[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#d4d4d8]The stand changes size when rotated.[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#d4d4d8]By default, a stand will be added to Robin's shop from the second year onwards. (Randomly sold)[/color][/size]
[size=2][color=#d4d4d8]Alternatively, you can obtain it from the vanilla furniture catalog.[/color][/size]

[color=#d4d4d8][size=2]Currently, English and Japanese translation files are included. [/size][/color]



[center][color=#d4d4d8][size=1]( If you like this mod or any of the mods I've created, please endorse it! It improves my willingness to make mods!)[/size][/color][/center]
